title: 254.  Cultivating a hot, smart, rich mindset ft. Maggie Sellers

sentences.en: This is an iHeart Podcast, Guaranteed Human.
sentences.zh: 这是一档 iHeart 播客，保证由真人制作。

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在努力以一种现实的方式优先考虑我的健康，而让我保持动力的一个因素就是我的 WHOOP。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常看重数据的人，这就是我喜欢 WHOOP 的原因，因为我可以真正看出为什么我的身体在不同日子里会有不同的感觉，为什么我跑步的状态不同，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我有时注意力不太集中。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP 可以轻松追踪我的睡眠、身体压力、恢复情况、压力水平，最重要的是，我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供了所有这些数据和模式，让我能够做出更好的决策，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该努力。

sentences.en: New members can try WHOOP with a 30-day free trial before committing to a membership.
sentences.zh: 新用户在正式订阅之前，可以先通过 WHOOP 的 30 天免费试用期进行体验。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com/psychology 即可免费获得一个月的 WHOOP 体验。

sentences.en: What's the one precious item you'd never throw away?
sentences.zh: 你有什么绝对不会扔掉的珍贵物品吗？

sentences.en: A movie ticket, a boarding pass, or maybe something that makes no sense to anyone but you.
sentences.zh: 一张电影票、一张登机牌，或者某种对别人来说毫无意义但对你却意义非凡的东西。

sentences.en: In the new podcast Charmed with Sam Todd,
sentences.zh: 在全新的播客《Charmed with Sam Todd》中，

sentences.en: Sam explores the memories, obsessions, and tiny treasures that become part of who you are.
sentences.zh: Sam 探索了那些成为你生命一部分的记忆、执念和微小的珍宝。

sentences.en: Charmed is warm, it's funny, it's nostalgic, and just full of the little moments and memories that make life matter.
sentences.zh: 《Charmed》温暖、有趣、怀旧，充满了让生活变得有意义的点滴瞬间和回忆。

sentences.en: Charmed with Sam Todd.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识山姆·托德。

sentences.en: Stories worn to tell with Pandora.
sentences.zh: 与 Pandora 一起讲述那些值得铭记的故事。

sentences.en: Listen now on iHeart.
sentences.zh: 现在就在 iHeart 上收听吧。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: A sincere welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 真诚地欢迎大家回到本期播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are on this world, on this planet, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 无论你是新听众还是老听众，无论你身处世界的哪个角落，很高兴你能回来收听新一期节目，我们将一起剖析 20 多岁时的心理状态。

sentences.en: There are some people out there who we can just all agree we basically aspire to be.
sentences.zh: 有些人的确是我们大家公认的奋斗目标。

sentences.en: The people who have it all.
sentences.zh: 那些拥有一切的人。

sentences.en: They're intelligent.
sentences.zh: 他们聪明。

sentences.en: They're business-minded.
sentences.zh: 他们有商业头脑。

sentences.en: They take care of themselves and their relationships.
sentences.zh: 他们照顾好自己和人际关系。

sentences.en: They are kind, they are confident, they are hot, smart, and rich, to use the catchphrase of our guests today.
sentences.zh: 他们善良、自信，用我们今天嘉宾的口头禅来说，他们既火辣、聪明又富有。

sentences.en: I think we can learn a lot from these kinds of individuals and the mindset that they have cultivated for themselves.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们可以从这些人身上，以及他们为自己培养的心态中学到很多东西。

sentences.en: I don't talk about entrepreneurship or business a lot on this podcast because it is a psychology podcast, but when we get down to it, there is a lot of psychology involved,
sentences.zh: 我在这档播客里很少谈论创业或商业，因为这是一档心理学播客，但归根结底，其中涉及很多心理学知识，

sentences.en: and I do get so many questions about it revolving around how you can take risks on yourself, how you can find your niche, what is the secret to being successful
sentences.zh: 而且我确实收到了很多关于这方面的问题，围绕着如何为自己冒险、如何找到自己的定位、成功的秘诀是什么，

sentences.en: and creative in your 20s, and how can we balance all of that ambition whilst also having a fierce, confident aura, cultivating wealth in our life in whatever form.
sentences.zh: 以及如何在 20 多岁时保持创造力，如何在拥有强烈、自信的气场的同时平衡所有这些野心，并以任何形式在生活中积累财富。

sentences.en: And I was lucky enough to find someone who has discovered that very formula.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运找到了一个发现了这个秘诀的人。

sentences.en: Today, we have on a special guest, the founder of Hot, Smart, and Rich, Maggie Sellers.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们邀请到了一位特别嘉宾，“火辣、聪明、富有”（Hot, Smart, and Rich）的创始人，Maggie Sellers。

sentences.en: Maggie, can you introduce yourself?
sentences.zh: Maggie，你能自我介绍一下吗？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 首先，非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: I'm truly honored.
sentences.zh: 我真的感到非常荣幸。

sentences.en: It's also so interesting hearing your voice over Zoom because I feel like I've heard it in my ears for so long, and I'm just so grateful to be here.
sentences.zh: 通过 Zoom 听到你的声音感觉很奇妙，因为我觉得我的耳朵里已经听了你很久了，能来到这里我真的非常感激。

sentences.en: But yeah, I'm Maggie Sellers.
sentences.zh: 我是 Maggie Sellers。

sentences.en: I'm also from a commonwealth country, Canada.
sentences.zh: 我也来自一个英联邦国家，加拿大。

sentences.en: I emigrated to the US almost seven years ago to work in really high-growth startups.
sentences.zh: 我大约七年前移民到美国，在一些高增长的初创公司工作。

sentences.en: I was in high-growth startups for a super long time, and then I ended up really having this lightbulb moment where I realized celebrities were the future of distribution
sentences.zh: 我在高增长的初创公司待了很长时间，后来我突然灵光一现，意识到名人是未来分发渠道的关键，

sentences.en: to reach a new audience at a super inexpensive way.
sentences.zh: 能以极低的成本触达新的受众。

sentences.en: So I ended up working for some of the biggest celebrities in the world at a management company.
sentences.zh: 所以我最终在一家管理公司为世界上一些最大的名人工作。

sentences.en: I helped build some brands for them.
sentences.zh: 我帮助他们建立了一些品牌。

sentences.en: I did brand partnerships, creative strategy, and then I fell in love with early-stage investing when a lot of young brands would come to us
sentences.zh: 我负责品牌合作、创意策略，后来我爱上了早期投资，当时很多年轻品牌会来找我们，

sentences.en: in exchange for equity, ownership in their brand, versus cash, ended up launching a corporate venture arms record label or record labels corporate venture arm.
sentences.zh: 用股权或品牌所有权来换取现金，我最终启动了一个企业风险投资部门，或者说是唱片公司的企业风险投资部门。

sentences.en: And then I've spent the last two years really building HSR as a media company, media investment holding company to empower women to become their hottest, smartest, richest self.
sentences.zh: 过去两年，我一直在将 HSR 打造成一家媒体公司和媒体投资控股公司，旨在赋能女性，让她们成为最火辣、最聪明、最富有的自己。

sentences.en: We started with short-form content.
sentences.zh: 我们从短视频内容起步。

sentences.en: We're very quickly expanding into long-form content, and I'm just so grateful every single day to be helping make an impact in so many incredible women's lives
sentences.zh: 我们正在迅速扩展到长视频内容，我每天都非常感激能帮助这么多不可思议的女性产生影响，

sentences.en: to just be authentically themselves.
sentences.zh: 让她们能够真实地做自己。

sentences.en: Oh my goodness.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个了。

sentences.en: I love everything that it stands for, especially since you know your shit.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它所代表的一切，尤其是因为你真的很懂行。

sentences.en: You embody the hot, smart, rich ethos, and not in the way that I think people typically think.
sentences.zh: 你体现了“火辣、聪明、富有”的精神，而且不是我认为人们通常理解的那种方式。

sentences.en: It's such a mindset thing for you, and just I think an incredible mission to just be like women can have a space in like male-dominated spaces.
sentences.zh: 这对你来说是一种心态，而且我认为这是一个不可思议的使命，就是让女性在男性主导的空间里拥有一席之地。

sentences.en: They can do it all.
sentences.zh: 她们可以做到这一切。

sentences.en: Like they are smart.
sentences.zh: 她们很聪明。

sentences.en: They can be wealthy.
sentences.zh: 她们可以变得富有。

sentences.en: They can be like this attractive, confident force.
sentences.zh: 她们可以成为那种既有吸引力又自信的力量。

sentences.en: What was like, you kind of explained
sentences.zh: 你是怎么，你刚才解释了

sentences.en: how you came to develop Hot, Smart, Rich.
sentences.zh: 你是如何开发出“火辣、聪明、富有”这个概念的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What was like your motivation?
sentences.zh: 你的动力是什么？

sentences.en: Was there like a lightbulb moment for you where you were like, people kind of need this.
sentences.zh: 有没有那么一个灵光一现的时刻，让你觉得人们需要这个？

sentences.en: Like we need like a finance broad community for women.
sentences.zh: 比如我们需要一个为女性打造的金融交流社区。

sentences.en: Yeah, so badly.
sentences.zh: 是的，太需要了。

sentences.en: I think it's like a lot of little moments in my life that laddered up to finally being able to take the plunge of just people thinking one thing about me
sentences.zh: 我觉得是我生命中许多小瞬间累积起来，最终让我下定决心，不再在意别人对我的看法，

sentences.en: or these kind of passive-aggressive compliments or backhanded compliments of like, oh, you're so much nicer than I thought you were.
sentences.zh: 或者那些被动攻击的恭维，或者是那种话里有话的夸奖，比如“哦，你比我想象中好相处多了”。

sentences.en: You're actually really smart.
sentences.zh: “你其实真的很聪明”。

sentences.en: And I think I just over time felt really worn down by those small things.
sentences.zh: 我觉得随着时间的推移，这些小事真的让我感到很疲惫。

sentences.en: But then there were obviously a lot of like bigger moments in people's lives that just make you realize that you want to make a change.
sentences.zh: 但显然，人们生活中也有很多更大的时刻，让你意识到自己想要做出改变。

sentences.en: And there's one story in particular that always comes back to me where I was working at a startup and I was taking on so much responsibility
sentences.zh: 有一个故事我特别印象深刻，当时我在一家初创公司工作，我承担了太多的责任，

sentences.en: and just like doing what I did at every startup, which was acting as if it was my own, working crazy hours, more responsibility, no more money.
sentences.zh: 就像我在每家初创公司做的那样，把公司当成自己的，工作时间长得离谱，责任越来越大，但薪水却没涨。

sentences.en: And I had been negotiating back and forth with my male boss at the time, trying to just like advocate for myself and be taken seriously.
sentences.zh: 当时我和我的男性老板反复谈判，试图为自己争取权益，希望被认真对待。

sentences.en: And there was just this moment where he was like, I just don't think that you're worth it.
sentences.zh: 有一次他竟然说：“我觉得你不值这个价。”

sentences.en: And I was like, well, then I'm going to leave.
sentences.zh: 我说，那我就辞职。

sentences.en: And I never thought that he would let me leave.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过他会真的让我走。

sentences.en: I thought ultimately it was gonna be like, of course I would never let you leave.
sentences.zh: 我以为他最终会说，我当然不会让你走。

sentences.en: And I left and I had no idea what I was gonna do.
sentences.zh: 但我还是走了，当时我完全不知道自己要做什么。

sentences.en: I had 60 days to get deported back to Canada because of my visa status and I just had to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 因为签证问题，我只有 60 天的时间，否则就会被遣返回加拿大，我必须想办法解决。

sentences.en: And it was this really interesting moment where everything I had known kind of melted away and it was just like, I bet 100% on myself.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常有趣的时刻，我所熟悉的一切都烟消云散了，我只能孤注一掷，百分之百地押注在自己身上。

sentences.en: And I think it was through the last three or four years of working mostly for men, mostly for men talent, mostly just around men in this space
sentences.zh: 我想，在过去三四年里，我大部分时间都是为男性工作，为男性人才工作，在这个领域里大部分时间都围绕着男性，

sentences.en: where I didn't have the same credentials that a lot of them had.
sentences.zh: 而我并没有他们那样的资历。

sentences.en: I didn't go to an Ivy League school.
sentences.zh: 我没有上过常春藤盟校。

sentences.en: I didn't go to invest in banking.
sentences.zh: 我没有从事过投资银行工作。

sentences.en: I didn't have any connections.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何人脉。

sentences.en: Like I've built my entire network myself for seven years since I got here.
sentences.zh: 我来到这里七年了，我所有的关系网都是我自己建立的。

sentences.en: And I just realized how lonely I felt, but how much I loved what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 我意识到自己感到多么孤独，但我又多么热爱我所做的事情。

sentences.en: And I was like, I wish there was just more people that I could do this with that I related to.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，要是能有更多和我一样的人一起做这件事就好了。

sentences.en: And then there was this other light bulb moment where I saw a lot of deals and it was often geared towards selling to women.
sentences.zh: 然后又有一个灵光一现的时刻，我看到了很多交易，它们通常都是为了向女性销售产品。

sentences.en: And women control 85% of consumer spend in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 女性控制着美国 85% 的消费支出。

sentences.en: Yet we get 2% of venture dollars.
sentences.zh: 但我们只获得了 2% 的风险投资资金。

sentences.en: And it was often men that were getting the deals, going to their wives or their girlfriends or their friends and asking for like, do you use this or what products compute this?
sentences.zh: 而且往往是男性在获得这些交易，他们去问他们的妻子、女朋友或朋友：“你用这个吗？或者什么产品能替代这个？”

sentences.en: And I'm like, women are literally giving away the secrets to make men wealthy because we control the spend.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，女性实际上是在把让男性致富的秘密拱手相让，因为我们控制着消费。

sentences.en: We know what people are buying.
sentences.zh: 我们知道人们在买什么。

sentences.en: So if I can help tell women that what actually makes them good consumers is what would make you a good business person or a good investor,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我能告诉女性，让她们成为好消费者的特质，同样也能让她们成为好的商人或投资者，

sentences.en: then I'm actually going to teach the fisherman to fish, not just give him the fish.
sentences.zh: 那么我就是在授人以渔，而不仅仅是给她们鱼。

sentences.en: And so that's kind of what started and I think just has spiraled from there to be so much like of a mission for me.
sentences.zh: 这就是一切的开端，我觉得从那以后，这对我来说已经演变成了一个使命。

sentences.en: But it's been really fun along the way, which I honestly haven't been able to say.
sentences.zh: 这一路走来真的很有趣，说实话，我以前从未有过这种感觉。

sentences.en: I've had a lot of excitement in my career, but I haven't had fun like every single day because I really am like the only writer of my destiny now.
sentences.zh: 我的职业生涯中有很多令人兴奋的时刻，但我并没有每天都感到快乐，因为现在我真的是自己命运的唯一掌控者。

sentences.en: Honestly, like hearing you talk about this,
sentences.zh: 说实话，听你谈论这些，

sentences.en: I'm getting so inspired.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常受鼓舞。

sentences.en: Yeah, I have like no interest in like investing or in venture capital.
sentences.zh: 是的，我对投资或风险投资其实没什么兴趣。

sentences.en: And I'm like, what am I going to invest in next?
sentences.zh: 但我现在在想，我接下来该投资什么呢？

sentences.en: Like, my money is my power.
sentences.zh: 我的钱就是我的力量。

sentences.en: I've never really considered it, which is probably not a great thing to own up to.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未真正考虑过这个问题，承认这一点可能不太好。

sentences.en: But I think that's part of the problem is that we are not encouraged to even think about the little things that we can do.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这就是问题的一部分，我们甚至没有被鼓励去思考我们可以做的那些小事。

sentences.en: And I think that is where the way that women think about money is just so fundamentally different than the way that men think about money
sentences.zh: 我认为女性看待金钱的方式与男性看待金钱的方式有着根本的不同，

sentences.en: that it's almost just changing the perception of how hard it is to even think about it.
sentences.zh: 以至于这几乎改变了人们对思考金钱这件事难度的看法。

sentences.en: It's like getting people excited to talk about it is part of what the purpose is.
sentences.zh: 让人们对谈论金钱感到兴奋，这就是目的的一部分。

sentences.en: Like, I will come on record and say, I know what I'm good at, I know what I'm not.
sentences.zh: 我可以公开地说，我知道自己擅长什么，也知道自己不擅长什么。

sentences.en: If you want to be a, you know, Wall Street guru ninja,
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为华尔街的投资大咖，

sentences.en: I'm probably not the person that's going to teach you how to do that, but I will teach you how to change your mindset towards money,
sentences.zh: 我可能不是教你如何做到那一点的人，但我会教你如何改变对金钱的心态，

sentences.en: your mindset towards how you think about yourself, your mindset towards how you think about collaboration.
sentences.zh: 改变你对自己的看法，改变你对合作的看法。

sentences.en: And there will be tips and tricks along the way and a community to help you build whatever your dream is, whether it's starting a company, investing in a company,
sentences.zh: 这一路上会有各种技巧和窍门，还会有一个社区来帮助你实现你的梦想，无论是创办公司、投资公司，

sentences.en: being the head of marketing or whatever your career ambition is for you.
sentences.zh: 还是担任市场总监，或者无论你的职业抱负是什么。

sentences.en: What I found really interesting about what you just said was how we think about money.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说的话里，有一点让我觉得非常有趣，那就是我们如何看待金钱。

sentences.en: And what's really interesting is that my mom is actually an economist, which a lot of people don't know.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我妈妈其实是一位经济学家，很多人都不知道这一点。

sentences.en: And so you would think that I have this attitude towards money that would be very different and very rational and very kind of accumulative.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会认为我对金钱的态度会非常不同，非常理性，非常注重积累。

sentences.en: But I just feel like I was then socialized like at school and at university to see this group of people who cared about, you know, wealth management
sentences.zh: 但我感觉我在学校和大学里被社会化了，看到那群人关心财富管理、

sentences.en: and wealth growth and investing and all those things.
sentences.zh: 财富增长、投资等等。

sentences.en: And I was like, I don't see myself represented there.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我在那里看不到自己的影子。

sentences.en: Like I see myself in this more emotional side of things.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己更倾向于情感层面。

sentences.en: I see that myself in this more like psychological side.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己更倾向于心理层面。

sentences.en: So the fact that you have come up with essentially what is like a coaching brand almost, like this whole brand.
sentences.zh: 所以，你创造了一个本质上像是教练品牌的品牌，这真的很棒。

sentences.en: And the primary thing I think for you is how do we get strong, independent women over their imposter syndrome?
sentences.zh: 而且我认为对你来说，最重要的事情是如何让坚强、独立的女性克服冒名顶替综合症？

sentences.en: And how do we make it so that you see yourself represented in the space that previously you thought you didn't deserve to be in?
sentences.zh: 以及我们如何让你在曾经认为自己不配进入的空间里看到自己的影子？

sentences.en: Or whether that's launching your own business, whether that's in like your dream career, whether that's like dating the people you want to date,
sentences.zh: 无论是创办自己的企业，还是追求梦想的职业，还是与你想约会的人约会，

sentences.en: like speaking your opinion in like a crowded room.
sentences.zh: 还是在拥挤的房间里大声说出自己的观点。

sentences.en: One of my favorite taglines that you have is like you are the CEO of a slow life in a fast world.
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的标语之一是“你是快节奏世界中慢生活的 CEO”。

sentences.en: Now, I think that's really important to pull out here
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为在这里提出来这一点非常重要，

sentences.en: because you know I love the slow life.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道我喜欢慢生活。

sentences.en: You know I love the soft life, the gentle life, where it's not all focused on like productivity and like doing as much as you can.
sentences.zh: 你知道我喜欢那种柔软、温和的生活，而不是一切都聚焦于生产力，聚焦于做尽可能多的事情。

sentences.en: And you kind of spoke about how when you were doing that, you were so burnt out and you still had people, your boss say to you like, well, you're still not worth it.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到当你那样做的时候，你感到非常精疲力竭，但人们，你的老板还是会对你说，你还是不值这个价。

sentences.en: What does it mean to you now, having started your own company?
sentences.zh: 现在，创办了自己的公司，这对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: How do you embody this like slow life in a fast world or in the fast lane, I guess?
sentences.zh: 你是如何在快节奏的世界或快车道中体现这种慢生活的？

sentences.en: It's such a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常棒的问题。

sentences.en: And it's something that I feel so passionate about because I think that we have totally just gone down the wrong way of productivity.
sentences.zh: 这也是我非常热衷的事情，因为我认为我们在生产力方面完全走错了方向。

sentences.en: People think busyness is productivity and it is so not, am I busy?
sentences.zh: 人们认为忙碌就是生产力，但根本不是，我很忙吗？

sentences.en: Of course I am.
sentences.zh: 当然很忙。

sentences.en: But I'll give you a great example and a great story.
sentences.zh: 但我给你举个很好的例子，讲个故事。

sentences.en: I have been traveling a lot more than normal.
sentences.zh: 我最近的旅行比平时多得多。

sentences.en: I just got back on Monday, it's Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 我周一刚回来，今天是周三。

sentences.en: I'm leaving again on Saturday for two weeks to go to India.
sentences.zh: 我周六又要离开两周去印度。

sentences.en: I have so many things going on in my life this week.
sentences.zh: 这周我的生活里有很多事情要处理。

sentences.en: I've injured my back.
sentences.zh: 我的背部受伤了。

sentences.en: So I have a spine, a specialist appointment.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一个脊椎专家的预约。

sentences.en: I have all these doctor's appointments.
sentences.zh: 我有所有的医生预约。

sentences.en: I have all these commitments that I've made.
sentences.zh: 我有所有我做出的承诺。

sentences.en: And I could start to feel myself just be like, how am I going to do this?
sentences.zh: 我开始感到自己要崩溃了，心想我该怎么做呢？

sentences.en: And the old me would have been like, wake up at 6 a.m., go to bed at 12, like coffee, coffee, like skip my workouts, skip my mental health.
sentences.zh: 以前的我可能会想，早上 6 点起床，12 点睡觉，喝咖啡，喝咖啡，跳过锻炼，放弃心理健康。

sentences.en: And that is just so detrimental to the longevity of building a marathon versus a sprint of a business that I sat down with myself and I was like,
sentences.zh: 这种做法对建立长久事业的损害极大，相比之下，那种只顾短期冲刺的经营方式完全不可取，所以我坐下来反思，心想，

sentences.en: what are the three most important things of the business?
sentences.zh: 事业中最重要的三件事是什么？

sentences.en: Okay, what are the three most important things underneath that?
sentences.zh: 好，那这三件事之下最重要的三件事又是什么？

sentences.en: Then I wrote down, is there anything that I can delegate?
sentences.zh: 然后我写下来，看看有什么是我可以授权给别人做的？

sentences.en: Is there anything that I can take off of my calendar to be able to accomplish everything?
sentences.zh: 有什么是我可以从日程表中剔除，从而确保一切都能顺利完成的？

sentences.en: And once you break things down very easily, you're able to understand how, yes, there are things that are really important that people are relying on you for,
sentences.zh: 一旦你把事情拆解得足够简单，你就会明白，没错，确实有些事情非常重要，别人也确实在依赖你，

sentences.en: but there's something that my boyfriend recently just taught me that I ask myself every single day when I'm feeling overwhelmed is, is this urgent or is this important?
sentences.zh: 但我男朋友最近教了我一招，每当我感到不知所措时，我都会问自己：这件事是紧急的，还是重要的？

sentences.en: Because urgency is typically somebody else's to-do list and it is not your job to do somebody else's to-do liSt.
sentences.zh: 因为“紧急”通常只是别人的待办事项，而替别人完成他们的待办事项并不是你的工作。

sentences.en: It is your job to do what is important for you, your business, your company that you work for, or your career.
sentences.zh: 你的工作是完成对你自己、对你的事业、对你所效力的公司或你的职业生涯而言重要的事情。

sentences.en: And so instead of tackling somebody else's urgent to-do list, it is the most important for you to do what's important for you and everybody else can wait.
sentences.zh: 所以，与其去处理别人那些紧急的待办事项，不如优先处理对你而言重要的事情，其他人的事都可以等一等。

sentences.en: And so there's like little tips and tricks that you can do where, you know, you can just do different time blocking, day blocking.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可以运用一些小技巧，比如尝试不同的时间分块或日期分块法。

sentences.en: Sometimes I even put out an out-of-office just saying I'm going to be slow to respond because of X, Y, and Z.
sentences.zh: 有时我甚至会设置自动回复，说明因为某些原因，我回复消息会比较慢。

sentences.en: And yes, if you work at a big corporation, there might be things you have to work through with your manager, but I do think that if you are really transparent
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你在大公司工作，可能有些事情必须与经理沟通，但我认为，只要你足够透明，

sentences.en: and you have great communication and you explain what you are doing, you should all be working towards the same goal.
sentences.zh: 保持良好的沟通，并解释清楚你在做什么，你们的目标应该是一致的。

sentences.en: It is easier for people now to be able to work together when you still have boundaries.
sentences.zh: 在保持边界感的同时，人们现在更容易协同工作了。

sentences.en: I absolutely 100% agree.
sentences.zh: 我百分之百同意。

sentences.en: And also something that we say a lot on the podcast, right?
sentences.zh: 这也是我们在播客里经常说的一点，对吧？

sentences.en: Boundaries are a sign of respect.
sentences.zh: 边界感是尊重的体现。

sentences.en: Boundaries are a sign of dedication, loyalty, and love.
sentences.zh: 边界感是奉献、忠诚和爱的体现。

sentences.en: Because the time that I have had the least amount of boundaries has actually been when I've disappointed the most people.
sentences.zh: 因为我最缺乏边界感的时候，恰恰是我最让别人失望的时候。

sentences.en: Because-
sentences.zh: 因为——

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Like you overcommit, you say you can do something because you don't want to let them down.
sentences.zh: 比如你过度承诺，答应做某事只是因为不想让对方失望。

sentences.en: Whereas if you had the boundary of saying,
sentences.zh: 而如果你有边界感，直接说：

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I'm clocking off at six and that's that, you know, you don't impress upon someone that you can do more than you can do.
sentences.zh: “抱歉，我六点下班，就这样。”你知道，这样你就不会给别人留下你能做更多事情的错觉。

sentences.en: And I remember being like, when I was at my corporate job, like working as a management consultant,
sentences.zh: 我记得以前在企业工作时，做管理咨询，

sentences.en: I was in Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 当时我在墨尔本。

sentences.en: I live in Sydney now and my family all live in Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 我现在住在悉尼，但我的家人都住在墨尔本。

sentences.en: And it was my grandma's birthday and I had promised to go to her birthday dinner.
sentences.zh: 那是我奶奶的生日，我答应过要去参加她的生日晚宴。

sentences.en: And I'm at my job and I'm in a team of five men and it's not a gendered thing, but this is, it was gendered for me in that I didn't feel like I could say, hey guys,
sentences.zh: 当时我在一个由五名男性组成的团队里工作，这并不是性别歧视，但对我来说确实有性别差异，因为我觉得我没法开口说：嘿，伙计们，

sentences.en: like I'm going to go to my grandma's birthday.
sentences.zh: 我要去参加我奶奶的生日聚会。

sentences.en: Like it was this like emotional thing.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是一件很情绪化的事。

sentences.en: And I'm in this team of five men and we're doing a productivity report for a huge, like a huge consumer industry body in Australia.
sentences.zh: 当时我们团队正在为澳大利亚一个大型消费行业机构做生产力报告。

sentences.en: And my boss is like, sorry guys,
sentences.zh: 我的老板说：抱歉各位，

sentences.en: I'm going to need you all to stay till nine.
sentences.zh: 我需要你们所有人留下来加班到九点。

sentences.en: And I ended up, you know, still leaving, you know, I was like, yeah, yeah, sure I can do that.
sentences.zh: 最后我还是走了，当时我说：好，好，没问题，我可以加班。

sentences.en: But then I ended up leaving at eight instead of nine and then everyone was pissed at me and I was still late for like my grandma's birthday and she was,
sentences.zh: 但结果我八点就走了，而不是九点，结果每个人都对我感到不满，而且我还是错过了奶奶的生日，她当时，

sentences.en: I could see like quite upset.
sentences.zh: 我能看出她非常难过。

sentences.en: So if I just had the boundary of like, no,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我当时有边界感，说：不，

sentences.en: I'm sorry,
sentences.zh: 抱歉，

sentences.en: I'm happy to start earlier tomorrow, but I, this is a hard stop for me.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意明天早点开始工作，但这对我来说是底线。

sentences.en: It's like, no one would have been hurt.
sentences.zh: 这样的话，没人会受到伤害。

sentences.en: Yes, maybe they would have been initially disappointed, but there's a respect there of like, I respect you enough to be open about what I'm doing and what I needed outside of work.
sentences.zh: 是的，也许他们起初会感到失望，但这里面有一种尊重，即我足够尊重你，所以坦诚地告诉你我在做什么以及工作之外我需要什么。

sentences.en: And you better kind of respect me enough to say something, but because it was like this senior male figure in the organization and there were all these guys and like,
sentences.zh: 而且你最好也足够尊重我，但因为那是组织里的一位男性高管，而且团队里全是男性，

sentences.en: none of them really like had these family commitments.
sentences.zh: 他们中没人真正有这种家庭承诺。

sentences.en: I'm sure they did, just not at that time.
sentences.zh: 我相信他们肯定有，只是当时没有遇到这种情况。

sentences.en: Like it was so much harder to do it.
sentences.zh: 所以要做到这一点真的太难了。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, it's so funny.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很有趣。

sentences.en: I always say like words matter and language matters and you said,
sentences.zh: 我常说言语很重要，语言很重要，而你刚才说，

sentences.en: I'm sorry a lot and coming from a Canadian, it comes out of my mouth a lot.
sentences.zh: 你经常说“抱歉”，作为一个加拿大人，我也经常把这个词挂在嘴边。

sentences.en: But I think you said something really great where it's like, you say,
sentences.zh: 但我认为你刚才说得非常好，你可以说：

sentences.en: I actually, thank you for your understanding.
sentences.zh: “其实，感谢你的理解。”

sentences.en: I need to leave at 6 p.m.
sentences.zh: “我需要下午六点离开，

sentences.en: for my grandmother's birthday, which is a previous commitment, which I told you about.
sentences.zh: 去参加我奶奶的生日聚会，这是一个我之前就告知过你的预定安排。”

sentences.en: Thank you for your understanding.
sentences.zh: “感谢你的理解。”

sentences.en: I will be in the office tomorrow at 7 a.m., three hours earlier than when everybody else is getting in to finish my part of the work.
sentences.zh: “我明天早上七点就会到办公室，比其他人早三个小时，来完成我那部分的工作。”

sentences.en: And I'm happy to review it at a time that's like beneficial for both of us.
sentences.zh: “我很乐意在对我们双方都方便的时间进行复核。”

sentences.en: And yes, there are some bosses that will not respect that and want you to be this like scared person of like,
sentences.zh: 当然，有些老板不会尊重这一点，他们希望你表现得像个唯唯诺诺的人，不停地说：

sentences.en: I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: “实在抱歉。”

sentences.en: But that's also not an environment that you should want to work in long term because it's not fostering your success and development.
sentences.zh: 但那也不是你应该长期工作的环境，因为它不利于你的成功和发展。

sentences.en: And so I think it's things like just even again, like this is Hot Smart Rich is a mindset.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，就像我说的，“Hot Smart Rich”是一种思维方式。

sentences.en: It's like, how do we change people's language and change collaboration?
sentences.zh: 我们要如何改变人们的语言习惯和协作方式？

sentences.en: And so it's using language like thank you for your understanding versus I'm sorry because we shouldn't be sorry that we have a life outside of work.
sentences.zh: 所以要多用“感谢你的理解”而不是“抱歉”，因为我们不应该为拥有工作之外的生活而感到抱歉。

sentences.en: It's such people pleaser behavior on my part as well.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说也是一种讨好型人格的表现。

sentences.en: Also, the I'm sorry thing is something that I find myself doing.
sentences.zh: 另外，我也发现自己经常会说“抱歉”。

sentences.en: Is it a commonwealth thing?
sentences.zh: 这是英联邦国家的习惯吗？

sentences.en: I think it must be.
sentences.zh: 我想一定是。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is a really good habit to learn of switching the switching from being apologetic for taking up space and for standing up for yourself.
sentences.zh: 是的，改掉这种习惯真的很好，不要因为占据空间或坚持自我而感到抱歉，

sentences.en: That's not something that you need to feel sorry for to being like, thank you for respecting that.
sentences.zh: 那根本不需要道歉，应该说“谢谢你的尊重”。

sentences.en: Like, thank you for respecting my boundaries and my autonomy and actually just like respecting me as a person who is nuanced and who is not just their job,
sentences.zh: 比如“谢谢你尊重我的边界和自主权”，其实就是尊重我作为一个有血有肉的人，我不仅仅是我的工作，

sentences.en: who is not just a partner, who is not just anything.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是某个人的伴侣，不仅仅是任何单一的标签。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I want to move into our first topic of the day, which is how to be hot.
sentences.zh: 我想进入我们今天的第一话题：如何变得“Hot”（迷人/火辣）。

sentences.en: I've been approaching my health really differently this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我对待健康的方式非常不同。

sentences.en: I used to be really focused on maximizing and doing more and now I'm just realizing that if I listen to what my body needs, I perform way better and that's why
sentences.zh: 我过去总是专注于追求极致和做更多的事，但现在我意识到，如果我倾听身体的需求，我的表现会好得多，这就是为什么

sentences.en: I am obsessed with my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 我沉迷于我的 WHOOP 手环。

sentences.en: Truly, you guys, you know I'm such a data and information-driven person and I love opening my WHOOP app and seeing how my sleep, my stress, my strain is correlating with my mood,
sentences.zh: 真的，伙计们，你们知道我是一个非常注重数据和信息的人，我喜欢打开 WHOOP 应用，看看我的睡眠、压力和劳损如何与我的情绪、

sentences.en: with my running performance, with how I'm just feeling day-to-day.
sentences.zh: 跑步表现以及我日常的感觉相关联。

sentences.en: I'm not an elite athlete by any means, but I do really benefit and I also just really enjoy knowing more about my body and WHOOP also gives me these actionable,
sentences.zh: 我绝不是什么精英运动员，但我确实从中受益匪浅，而且我也真的很喜欢更多地了解自己的身体，WHOOP 还给了我这些可操作的、

sentences.en: personalized insights that have made me more intentional and meant that I make smarter decisions day-to-day about what I need rather than just putting my foot on the gas
sentences.zh: 个性化的见解，让我变得更有意向性，意味着我每天能做出更明智的决定，知道自己需要什么，而不是一味地踩油门，

sentences.en: and just going, going, going, going.
sentences.zh: 只知道不停地冲、冲、冲。

sentences.zh: 新用户可以尝试

sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com/psychology 即可获得一个月的免费 WHOOP 会员。

sentences.zh: 有些人会保留所有看过的演出门票。

sentences.en: It brings back the music, it brings back the memories, even the smells.
sentences.zh: 它能带回音乐，带回记忆，甚至带回当时的气味。

sentences.en: Other people collect perfume bottles or coffee mugs or overseas bank notes, classic sweaters from the 80s.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则收集香水瓶、咖啡杯、海外纸币，或是 80 年代的经典毛衣。

sentences.en: Collection is deeply personal.
sentences.zh: 收藏是非常私人的事情。

sentences.zh: 它诉说着我们是谁，也诉说着我们从哪里来。

sentences.zh: 在新的播客节目中，

sentences.zh: 很高兴认识山姆·托德，

sentences.en: Sam explores the memories, obsessions, and tiny treasures that become part of who we are.
sentences.zh: Sam 探索了那些成为我们一部分的记忆、痴迷和微小的珍宝。

sentences.zh: 《Charmed with Sam Todd》，由 Pandora 讲述的故事。

sentences.en: Okay, Maggie, hot, smart, rich.
sentences.zh: 好了，Maggie，Hot, Smart, Rich。

sentences.en: Hot is the first word in this sequence of beautiful words.
sentences.zh: “Hot”是这一系列美好词汇中的第一个。

sentences.en: What does it actually take to be quote-unquote hot?
sentences.zh: 要做到所谓的“Hot”到底需要什么？

sentences.en: Because I think we know it's not all physical.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为我们都知道这不仅仅是外表。

sentences.en: We all know that.
sentences.zh: 我们都明白这一点。

sentences.en: We want to be someone who is perceived as attractive, but it is actually more psychological than it is physical.
sentences.zh: 我们想成为被认为有吸引力的人，但这实际上更多是心理层面的，而非生理层面的。

sentences.en: It is a mental mindset.
sentences.zh: 这是一种精神心态。

sentences.en: How do we kind of activate that hot mindset for ourselves?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何为自己激活那种“Hot”的心态呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I love this question and I think, you know, it's so funny because people are always like so thrown off when they hear
sentences.zh: 是的，我喜欢这个问题，而且你知道，这很有趣，因为人们听到我说

sentences.en: I'm a hot, smart, rich girl.
sentences.zh: “我是一个 Hot, Smart, Rich 的女孩”时，总是感到很惊讶。

sentences.en: But I think to your point exactly, being hot is such a state of mind and it really starts with confidence because being your most confident self in whatever that is for you
sentences.zh: 但我觉得正如你所说，Hot 是一种心态，它始于自信，因为在任何情况下展现最自信的自己，

sentences.en: is what is true hotness to me.
